keys.description: Each column's sort key: a number, a list of numbers or text.

tones.description: Each column's tone (ok, warn, bad), or empty.

tips.description: Each column's tooltip, or empty (an age's: its time in full).

uid.description: What it is known by across reads.

owner_kind.description: What controls it: the kind, or empty.

owner_name.description: What controls it: the name, or empty.

containers.description: A pod's containers, init ones first.

default.description: A pod's default container (its annotation), or empty.
